verdict.rationale: SumUp's first-party docs state that Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone, with no separate card reader. The in-person payments overview and the Reader SDK docs confirm Tap to Pay as an alternative to physical readers. Missing for 10: details on which phones and regions are compatible and on the merchant setup flow, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without carrying a separate card reader.
SumUp's in-person payment products let you accept card payments face-to-face using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device.
Your app controls the reader over Bluetooth or uses Tap to Pay.
